question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?
rendered: The carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential by 19 - 12 = 7 mV, which is a 36.8% reduction of the bare-Al value of 19 mV.
